headline: The Nursing & Patient Care Master 20
threshold: By Lesson 20, you can precept a new nurse and have them teach a protocol back, explain an unplanned change to a patient or family, read back and escalate a critical result, talk through a fall or near miss without blame, and write the shift's incident and summary notes in Spanish.

lessons.title: Orienting a New Nurse to the Unit's Shift Rhythm
lessons.objective: Walk a new nurse through the unit's shift routine in order and explain why each step comes when it does.

words.note: The nurse's 'brain sheet' for jotting down each patient's to-dos.
Some units call them rondas de seguridad.
Many units just say el Pyxis or el Omnicell.
Many US units also say las rondas médicas.
The board in the patient's room; some say la pizarra.
Say la preceptora for a woman.

words.en: First we get report, and then we check on the patients.
words.es: Primero recibimos el reporte y luego revisamos a los pacientes.

words.en: We check glucose before breakfast, so that's why we start early.
words.es: Revisamos la glucosa antes del desayuno, por eso empezamos temprano.

words.en: After the med pass, we chart everything.
words.es: Después de la ronda de medicamentos, documentamos todo.

words.en: We check the labs before physician rounds because the doctors ask about them.
words.es: Revisamos los laboratorios antes del pase de visita porque los médicos preguntan.

words.en: Every hour we go by the rooms to check pain, position and toileting.
words.es: Cada hora pasamos por los cuartos para revisar dolor, posición y baño.

words.en: Why do you think we do rounds in this order?
words.es: ¿Por qué crees que hacemos las rondas en este orden?
words.note: Informal tú, to the new nurse.

words.en: Good morning, a new colleague is with me today, is that OK?
words.es: Buenos días, hoy me acompaña una compañera nueva, ¿está bien?
words.note: Formal, to the patient.

words.en: That's why we write everything down on the report sheet.
words.es: Por eso anotamos todo en la hoja de reporte.

lessons.speaking: You are the preceptor, and the AI is a new nurse shadowing you on day shift: walk her through the morning routine in order and explain why each step comes when it does, using primero, luego, después, porque and por eso.

grammar.focus: Connectors for sequence and cause (primero revisamos las alergias, luego..., porque..., por eso...)

examples.es: Primero revisamos las alergias en el expediente, luego vemos a los pacientes.
examples.en: First we check allergies in the chart, then we see the patients.

examples.es: Los médicos pasan a las 9, por eso revisamos los laboratorios antes.
examples.en: The doctors round at 9, so we check the labs before that.

lessons.title: Why We Double-Check High-Alert Medications
lessons.objective: Explain why the unit requires an independent double-check and have the new nurse explain it back.

words.note: Patients often say 'se me bajó el azúcar'.

words.en: According to policy, the insulin drip is checked by two nurses independently.
words.es: Según la política, el goteo de insulina lo verifican dos enfermeras por separado.

words.en: If the second signature is missing, the drip doesn't get hung.
words.es: Si falta la segunda firma, no se cuelga el goteo.

words.en: I understand you always checked it alone, but here it's done differently.
words.es: Entiendo que siempre lo revisabas sola, pero aquí se hace diferente.
words.note: Informal tú, to a female coworker.

words.en: The other nurse calculates it on her own, without seeing my numbers.
words.es: La otra enfermera lo calcula sola, sin ver mis números.

words.en: If the numbers don't match, you stop and check it again.
words.es: Si los números no coinciden, se detiene y se revisa otra vez.

words.en: An insulin error can cause severe hypoglycemia.
words.es: Un error con insulina puede causar una hipoglucemia grave.

words.en: Can you explain in your own words why we do this?
words.es: ¿Me puedes explicar con tus palabras por qué se hace esto?
words.note: Informal; a teach-back question for a coworker.

words.en: Excuse me, could you do the double-check on the drip for me?
words.es: Disculpe, ¿usted me puede hacer la doble verificación del goteo?
words.note: Formal, e.g. to a charge nurse you don't know well.

lessons.speaking: You are the experienced nurse, and the AI is a new nurse in the med room: explain why hospital policy requires an independent double-check on the insulin drip, using se verifica and si + present, then have her explain it back to you.

grammar.focus: Impersonal se; si + present for general truths (según la política del hospital, se verifica con dos enfermeras; si falta la segunda firma, no se administra)

examples.es: Según la política del hospital, la heparina en goteo se verifica con dos enfermeras.
examples.en: According to hospital policy, a heparin drip is verified by two nurses.

examples.es: Si falta la segunda firma, no se administra.
examples.en: If the second signature is missing, it isn't given.

lessons.title: Coaching a New Aide on a Bed-to-Chair Transfer
lessons.objective: Give clear step-by-step commands while a new CNA practices a bed-to-chair transfer, then correct and confirm.

words.note: Patients say 'se me bajó la presión' or 'me mareé'.
Say la asistente for a woman; many US units just say el or la CNA.

words.en: Hold him by the belt, don't pull him by the arm.
words.es: Sujétalo del cinturón, no lo jales del brazo.
words.note: Informal tú, to the aide.

words.en: Put the brakes on the chair before you move him.
words.es: Ponle los frenos a la silla antes de moverlo.

words.en: Bend your knees and keep your back straight.
words.es: Dobla las rodillas y mantén la espalda recta.

words.en: Sir, when I tell you, push with your hands and stand up.
words.es: Señor, cuando le diga, empuje con las manos y párese.
words.note: Formal usted, to the patient.

words.en: Pivot him slowly toward his strong side.
words.es: Gíralo despacio hacia su lado fuerte.

words.en: Lower him slowly into the chair without letting go of him.
words.es: Bájalo despacio al sillón, sin soltarlo.

words.en: Do you feel dizzy or weak, sir?
words.note: Formal, to the patient.

words.en: Very good, now you explain the steps to me in order.
words.es: Muy bien, ahora explícame tú los pasos en orden.

lessons.speaking: You are the nurse training the AI, a new CNA, on a bed-to-chair transfer of a weak post-op patient: give step-by-step commands like sujétalo del cinturón and bájalo despacio, correct the aide's technique, and confirm the steps.

grammar.focus: Commands with object pronouns (bájalo despacio, sujétalo del cinturón, no lo jales del brazo)

examples.es: Sujétalo del cinturón de transferencia, no del brazo.
examples.en: Hold him by the gait belt, not by the arm.

examples.es: No lo jales; guíalo hacia el sillón.
examples.en: Don't pull him; guide him toward the chair.

lessons.title: Reading the Transfusion Protocol with a New Nurse
lessons.objective: Read the hospital's blood transfusion protocol aloud with a new nurse and explain each check before and after.

words.note: At the bedside, with the patient and the wristband, not just the chart.
The tubing set for the blood; some nurses just say la línea de sangre.

words.en: Before hanging it, we have to verify the patient at the bedside.
words.es: Antes de colgarla, hay que verificar al paciente junto a la cama.

words.en: The chart matching isn't enough; we have to verify in person.
words.es: Que el expediente coincida no basta; hay que verificar en persona.

words.en: According to hospital protocol, we take vital signs before starting.
words.es: Según el protocolo del hospital, tomamos signos vitales antes de empezar.

words.en: According to the protocol, we stay with the patient for the first 15 minutes.
words.es: Según el protocolo, nos quedamos con el paciente los primeros 15 minutos.

words.en: Read me the unit number and I'll compare it with the label.
words.es: Léeme el número de unidad y yo lo comparo con la etiqueta.
words.note: Informal tú, to the new nurse.

words.en: Sir, can you tell me your full name and date of birth?
words.es: Señor, ¿me dice su nombre completo y su fecha de nacimiento?
words.note: Formal, to the patient.

words.en: If you get chills or itching, please let me know right away.
words.es: Si tiene escalofríos o comezón, avíseme enseguida, por favor.
words.note: Formal, to the patient.

words.en: What does the protocol say we have to do after it's finished?
words.es: ¿Qué dice el protocolo que hay que hacer después de terminar?

lessons.speaking: You are the experienced nurse, and the AI is a new nurse at the nurses' station: read the hospital's transfusion protocol aloud with her and explain each check before and after, using antes de / después de + infinitive and hay que.

grammar.focus: Antes de / después de + infinitive; hay que (antes de colgar la sangre hay que verificar la identidad, según el protocolo del hospital)

examples.es: Antes de colgar la sangre, hay que verificar la identidad, según el protocolo del hospital.
examples.en: Before hanging the blood, you have to verify identity, according to hospital protocol.

examples.es: Después de terminar la transfusión, hay que documentar la respuesta del paciente.
examples.en: After the transfusion is finished, you have to document the patient's response.

lessons.title: Pressure Injury Found Under a Leg Brace
lessons.objective: Describe a skin injury that was missed and propose a plan to the physician and the patient's daughter.

words.note: Older name, still common with patients and families.
The redness does not fade when you press on it.
Staging is done according to hospital policy, often confirmed by the wound nurse.
Use el enfermero de heridas for a man.

words.en: When I removed the brace, the heel was red, with a blister.
words.es: Cuando quité el aparato, el talón estaba rojo, con una ampolla.
words.note: Preterite for the action (quité), imperfect for what you saw (estaba).

words.en: You're right to ask; I also want to know what happened.
words.es: Tiene razón en preguntar; yo también quiero saber qué pasó.
words.note: Formal, to the daughter. Acknowledge her concern without blaming anyone.

words.en: I'm going to document it and report it according to hospital policy.
words.es: Voy a documentarlo y reportarlo según la política del hospital.

words.en: Doctor, I found a pressure injury on the heel, under the brace.
words.es: Doctor, encontré una lesión por presión en el talón, debajo del aparato.

words.en: I would request a consult with the wound care nurse today.
words.es: Yo pediría una consulta con la enfermera de heridas hoy mismo.
words.note: The conditional makes it a polite proposal, not a demand.

words.en: In the meantime, I would keep pressure off the heel, is that OK with you?
words.es: Mientras tanto, yo dejaría el talón sin presión, ¿le parece bien?
words.note: Formal, to the physician.

words.en: Sir, do you feel pain when I touch you here?
words.es: Señor, ¿siente dolor cuando lo toco aquí?
words.note: Formal, to the patient.

lessons.speaking: You are the nurse, and the AI is the patient's daughter and then the physician: describe the injury you found under the brace using preterite and imperfect (cuando quité el aparato, la piel estaba roja), and propose a plan with the conditional (yo pediría…).

grammar.focus: Preterite vs imperfect; conditional for the proposal (cuando quité el aparato, la piel estaba roja; yo pediría una consulta con la enfermera de heridas)

examples.es: Cuando quité el aparato, la piel estaba roja y tenía una ampolla.
examples.en: When I removed the brace, the skin was red and had a blister.

examples.es: Yo pediría una consulta con la enfermera de heridas.
examples.en: I would request a consult with the wound care nurse.

lessons.title: The Pharmacy Sent a Pill That Looks Different
lessons.objective: Confirm a substitution with pharmacy, then explain to the patient what changes and what stays the same.

words.note: For a woman; use el farmacéutico for a man.
The list of medications the hospital stocks.
The letters or numbers stamped on a pill.
Agrees with the noun: una pastilla distinta.

words.en: Don't worry, you don't have to take it until I confirm.
words.es: No se preocupe, no tiene que tomarla hasta que yo confirme.
words.note: Formal, to the patient.

words.en: I'm going to keep it here while I call the pharmacy.
words.es: La voy a guardar aquí mientras llamo a la farmacia.

words.en: This is the nurse from room 412; can you confirm a substitution for me?
words.es: Habla la enfermera del cuarto 412; ¿me confirma una sustitución?
words.note: Formal, to the pharmacist on the phone.

words.en: Is it the same active ingredient and the same dose?
words.es: ¿Es el mismo principio activo y la misma dosis?

words.en: According to the pharmacist, it's the same medication as the other one.
words.es: Según la farmacéutica, es el mismo medicamento que el otro.

words.en: Here in the hospital you're going to see a smaller pill in a different color.
words.es: Aquí en el hospital va a ver una pastilla más pequeña y de otro color.

words.en: What changes is the manufacturer; everything else stays the same.
words.es: Lo que cambia es el fabricante; lo demás sigue igual.

words.en: Do you have any questions before you take it?

lessons.speaking: You are the nurse, and the AI is a patient who won't take a pill that looks different and then the pharmacist: hold the pill, confirm the substitution by phone, and explain the change with ir a + infinitive, the future and comparisons (más pequeña que, el mismo que).

grammar.focus: Future and ir a; comparisons (va a ver una pastilla más pequeña; según la farmacéutica, es el mismo medicamento que el otro)

examples.es: Aquí en el hospital va a ver una pastilla más pequeña y blanca.
examples.en: Here in the hospital you're going to see a smaller, white pill.

examples.es: Esta pastilla es más pequeña que la otra, pero tiene la misma dosis.
examples.en: This pill is smaller than the other one, but it has the same dose.

lessons.title: Lab Calls with a Critical Result
lessons.objective: Take a critical lab value by phone, read it back exactly, and tell the physician what happened and when.

words.note: Also heard as hipercalemia.
Use la técnica de laboratorio for a woman.
Often shortened to el electro.
Use la supervisora de enfermería for a woman.

words.en: Reading back: potassium of 6.8 for Juan López, correct?
words.es: Repito: potasio de 6.8 para Juan López, ¿correcto?
words.note: Read back the name and the value, then wait for the caller to say correcto.

words.en: Can you give me your name and the time of the result, please?
words.es: ¿Me da su nombre y la hora del resultado, por favor?
words.note: Formal, to the lab technician.

words.en: The lab called at 10:42 and I read back the value.
words.es: El laboratorio llamó a las 10:42 y repetí el valor.

words.en: Doctor, I called you at 10:45 and at 10:55.
words.es: Doctor, lo llamé a las 10:45 y a las 10:55.

words.en: While I was waiting, I notified the charge nurse.
words.es: Mientras esperaba, le avisé a la enfermera encargada.

words.en: The patient is on telemetry and the rhythm hasn't changed.
words.es: El paciente está en telemetría y el ritmo no ha cambiado.

words.en: Let me repeat the order back to confirm I understood it correctly.
words.es: Le repito la orden para confirmar que la entendí bien.
words.note: Formal, to the physician. Read back every verbal order.

words.en: The lab says the sample isn't hemolyzed; do you want them to repeat the potassium?
words.es: El laboratorio dice que la muestra no está hemolizada; ¿quiere que repitan el potasio?

lessons.speaking: You are the nurse, and the AI is the lab technician and then the on-call physician: take the critical potassium result, read it back exactly, and report what happened and when, using the preterite with exact times (llamó a las…, repetí…, avisé…).

grammar.focus: Preterite narration; numbers under pressure (el laboratorio llamó a las 10:42, repetí el valor que me dieron y avisé al médico)

examples.es: El laboratorio llamó a las 10:42 y repetí el valor que me dieron.
examples.en: The lab called at 10:42 and I read back the value they gave me.

examples.es: Llamé al médico a las 10:45 y él contestó a las 11:05.
examples.en: I called the physician at 10:45 and he answered at 11:05.

lessons.title: Saying No to Pills Brought from Home
lessons.objective: Refuse kindly when a family wants to give the patient medicine from home, and offer a safe alternative.

words.en: Please don't give it to him yet.
words.es: Por favor, no se la dé todavía.
words.note: Formal negative command to the son; se la = it to him.

words.en: I understand you want to help your dad with the pain.
words.es: Entiendo que quiere ayudar a su papá con el dolor.

words.en: I don't recommend that he take anything the doctor hasn't ordered.
words.es: No recomiendo que tome nada que el médico no haya ordenado.
words.note: No recomiendo que is followed by the subjunctive (tome).

words.en: Together with what we already gave him, it could be dangerous.
words.es: Junto con lo que ya le dimos, podría ser peligroso.

words.en: I'll check right now when his pain medicine is due.
words.es: Ahora mismo reviso cuándo le toca su medicina para el dolor.

words.en: I'm going to ask the doctor to review his pain control.
words.es: Voy a pedirle al médico que revise su control del dolor.

words.en: According to policy, we keep the bag sealed or you take it home.
words.es: Según la política, guardamos la bolsa sellada o se la lleva.
words.note: Check your hospital's policy on home medications first.

words.en: Don't give him teas or home remedies without asking us either.
words.es: No le dé tampoco tés ni remedios caseros sin preguntarnos.
words.note: Formal.

lessons.speaking: You are the nurse, and the AI is the patient's son, who is about to give his father a pill from home: stop him kindly with negative commands (no se la dé), explain the risk with no recomiendo que + subjunctive, and offer a safe alternative.

grammar.focus: Negative commands; subjunctive after no recomiendo que (no se la dé, por favor; no recomiendo que tome nada que no esté en la orden del médico)

examples.es: No se la dé, por favor.
examples.en: Please don't give it to him.

examples.es: No recomiendo que tome nada que no esté en la orden del médico.
examples.en: I don't recommend that he take anything that isn't in the doctor's order.

lessons.title: Feedback to a New Grad After a Missed Reassessment
lessons.objective: Give a new nurse clear, respectful feedback on a missed pain reassessment and agree on next steps.

words.en: I'd like us to talk privately for a moment. Do you have time?
words.es: Quiero que hablemos un momento en privado, ¿tienes tiempo?
words.note: Informal: tú between coworkers

words.en: I'm not scolding you; I want us to go over it.
words.es: No te estoy regañando; quiero que lo revisemos.

words.en: I understand the shift was heavy, but this can't be skipped.
words.es: Entiendo que el turno estaba pesado, pero esto no se puede saltar.

words.en: I want you to document the reassessment every time you give a pain medication.
words.es: Quiero que documentes la reevaluación cada vez que des un analgésico.

words.en: I recommend that you set a reminder in the system.
words.es: Te recomiendo que pongas un recordatorio en el sistema.

words.en: It's important that you let me know if you're falling behind.
words.es: Es importante que me avises si te estás atrasando.

words.en: What do you need from me so it doesn't happen again?
words.es: ¿Qué necesitas de mí para que no vuelva a pasar?

words.en: I want you to feel you can ask me anything.
words.es: Quiero que me tengas confianza para preguntarme lo que sea.

lessons.speaking: You are the charge nurse, and the AI is a new graduate nurse who gave pain medicine but didn't reassess or chart the effect: talk privately, explain the gap respectfully and agree on next steps using quiero que and te recomiendo que with the present subjunctive.

grammar.focus: Present subjunctive after wishes and recommendations (quiero que lo documentes; te recomiendo que pongas un recordatorio)

examples.es: Quiero que documentes el dolor en cuanto reevalúes al paciente.
examples.en: I want you to document the pain as soon as you reassess the patient.

examples.es: Te recomiendo que pongas un recordatorio después de cada dosis.
examples.en: I recommend that you set a reminder after every dose.

lessons.title: Two Aides Arguing Over the Heavy Assignment
lessons.objective: Listen to both sides of a conflict between two CNAs, report what each said, and settle a fair plan.

words.note: Many US units also just say el Hoyer.
Informal, very common in Mexico

words.en: Please, not here; let's talk in the break room.
words.es: Por favor, aquí no; hablemos en la sala de descanso.

words.en: First I'll hear each of you out, without interrupting.
words.es: Primero escucho a cada quien, sin interrumpir.

words.en: Ana told me she had three total-care patients.
words.es: Ana me dijo que tenía tres pacientes de cuidado total.

words.en: And you told me you didn't know how they were being split.
words.es: Y tú me dijiste que no sabías cómo se repartían.
words.note: Informal: tú to a coworker

words.es: Los dos tienen razón en algo.

words.en: Starting today, the total-care patients go by rotation.
words.es: A partir de hoy, los pacientes de cuidado total van por rotación.

words.en: Help each other with the lift and the bed baths.
words.es: Ayúdense con la grúa y con los baños en cama.
words.note: Ustedes command to both aides

words.en: Right now the call lights come first; we'll keep talking after.
words.es: Ahorita las luces de llamada van primero; luego seguimos hablando.

lessons.speaking: You are the charge nurse, and the AI plays two CNAs arguing in the hallway: hear each side, report back what each said with ella dijo que and él dijo que plus the imperfect, and settle a fair rotation for the heavy patients.

grammar.focus: Reported speech; imperfect for background (ella dijo que siempre le tocaban los pacientes más pesados; él dijo que no lo sabía)

examples.es: Ana dijo que siempre le tocaban los pacientes de cuidado total.
examples.en: Ana said she always got the total-care patients.

examples.es: Luis dijo que no sabía que ella tenía tres el lunes.
examples.en: Luis said he didn't know she had three on Monday.

lessons.title: Keeping the Team Going on a Short-Staffed Night
lessons.objective: Encourage a tired team, divide the work and make clear commitments about what you will cover.

words.en: There are fewer of us tonight, but we'll get through it together.
words.es: Somos menos esta noche, pero lo lograremos juntos.

words.en: I'll take care of the admissions and the unstable patients.
words.es: Yo me encargaré de las admisiones y de los pacientes inestables.

words.en: You two will split the basic care by hallway.
words.es: Ustedes dos se repartirán el cuidado básico por pasillo.

words.en: I'll ask the supervisor for a float nurse.
words.es: Le pediré a la supervisora una enfermera flotante.

words.en: Everyone will take their break; I'll cover your patients.
words.es: Cada quien tomará su descanso; yo cubriré a sus pacientes.

words.en: If you fall behind, let me know and I'll help you.
words.es: Si se atrasan, avísenme y yo los ayudaré.

words.en: At 2 we'll meet here to see how we're doing.
words.es: A las 2 nos reuniremos aquí para ver cómo vamos.

words.en: You're doing great, really; thanks for the effort.
words.es: Vas muy bien, de veras; gracias por el esfuerzo.
words.note: Informal: tú to one coworker

lessons.speaking: You are the charge nurse, and the AI is the remaining nurse and two aides at the station: open the night with encouragement, divide the work, and state what you'll cover using the future, like yo me encargaré de and lo lograremos juntos.

grammar.focus: Future for commitments; encouragement register (yo me encargaré de las admisiones; lo lograremos juntos; vas muy bien)

examples.es: Yo me encargaré de las admisiones de esta noche.
examples.en: I'll take care of tonight's admissions.

examples.es: Lo lograremos juntos si nos avisamos a tiempo.
examples.en: We'll get through it together if we keep each other posted.

lessons.title: One Update, Four Listeners: Patient, Family, Doctor, Aide
lessons.objective: Give the same change in plan to a patient, a relative, a physician and an aide, adjusting register for each.

words.note: Nurses say en ayuno or nada por boca for NPO.

words.en: Mr. Ramírez, I have some news about your surgery.
words.es: Señor Ramírez, le tengo una noticia sobre su cirugía.
words.note: Formal: usted with the patient

words.en: Your surgery was moved to early tomorrow because of an emergency case.
words.es: Su cirugía se pasó para mañana temprano por un caso de emergencia.
words.note: Formal

words.en: Ma'am, I understand this worries you; he is stable.
words.es: Señora, entiendo que esto la preocupa; él está estable.
words.note: Formal: usted with the wife

words.en: I'd like to mention something, Doctor: the surgery was postponed until tomorrow.
words.es: Quisiera comentarle algo, doctora: la cirugía se pospuso para mañana.
words.note: Formal softener for a physician

words.en: Could you update the diet order and the pre-op orders?
words.es: ¿Podría actualizar la orden de dieta y las órdenes preoperatorias?
words.note: Formal

words.en: Hey, can you help me take dinner to the gentleman in 305?
words.es: Oye, ¿me ayudas a llevarle la cena al señor del 305?
words.note: Informal: tú with a coworker

words.en: According to the new order, he can have dinner and is NPO from midnight.
words.es: Según la nueva orden, puede cenar y queda en ayuno desde medianoche.

words.en: Would you like me to let you know when they confirm the time?
words.es: ¿Le gustaría que le avisara cuando confirmaran la hora?
words.note: Formal

lessons.speaking: You are the nurse, and the AI plays the patient, his wife, the resident and the aide in turn: tell each that the surgery moved to tomorrow, using usted and softeners like quisiera comentarle with the first three, and tú with the aide (oye, ¿me ayudas…?).

grammar.focus: Usted / tú switching; softeners (quisiera comentarle, doctora...; oye, ¿me ayudas con...?)

examples.es: Disculpe, doctora, ¿tendría un minuto para revisar la orden de dieta?
examples.en: Excuse me, Doctor, would you have a minute to review the diet order?

examples.es: Oye, ¿me ayudas con el señor del 305? Ya no va a cirugía hoy.
examples.en: Hey, can you help me with the gentleman in 305? He's not going to surgery today anymore.

lessons.title: Unwitnessed Fall at 3 a.m.: The Incident Report
lessons.objective: Narrate an unwitnessed fall in clear time order for the incident report, the physician and the family.

words.note: Used for a visible bruise or a swelling under the skin.
Only the physician orders it; you report and follow the order.
desorientada for a woman.
In the report, quote exactly what the patient said.

words.en: At 3:10 I found him on the floor.
words.es: A las 3:10 lo encontré en el piso.

words.en: Before that, at 2, he was asleep and calm.
words.es: Antes de eso, a las 2, estaba dormido y tranquilo.

words.en: Before moving him, I checked his head and his vital signs.
words.es: Antes de moverlo, le revisé la cabeza y los signos vitales.

words.en: Then I called the on-call physician and the supervisor.
words.es: Después llamé al médico de guardia y a la supervisora.

words.en: Doctor, nobody saw him fall; he has a bruise on his forehead, so he probably hit his head.
words.es: Doctor, nadie lo vio caer; tiene un hematoma en la frente, así que probablemente se golpeó la cabeza.
words.note: Formal, to the physician.

words.en: Ma'am, I'm calling because your father fell tonight.
words.es: Señora, la llamo porque su papá se cayó esta noche.
words.note: Formal, to the family.

words.en: We don't know yet why the alarm failed; we're looking into it.
words.es: No sabemos aún por qué falló la alarma; lo estamos revisando.
words.note: Honest and calm; don't guess or blame anyone.

words.en: In the report I write what I saw, not what I assume.
words.es: En el informe escribo lo que vi, no lo que supongo.

lessons.speaking: You are the night nurse, and the AI is the patient's daughter on the phone: tell her about her father's fall in clear time order with a las…, antes de eso and después, using the preterite and imperfect, and answer her questions about the bed alarm honestly.

grammar.focus: Past narration with time markers (a las tres y diez lo encontré en el piso; antes de eso, a las dos, estaba dormido; después llamé al médico)

examples.es: A las 3:10 lo encontré en el piso; antes de eso, a las 2, estaba dormido.
examples.en: At 3:10 I found him on the floor; before that, at 2, he was asleep.

examples.es: Después de revisarlo, llamé al médico y luego a su hija.
examples.en: After checking him, I called the physician and then his daughter.

lessons.title: Near Miss: Two Patients with the Same Last Name
lessons.objective: Talk through a near miss without blame and agree with the team on a change that prevents it next time.

words.note: Also cuasi error; many staff just say 'near miss.'
Many units just say 'el huddle.'

words.en: We almost gave the medication to the wrong patient.
words.es: Por poco le damos la medicina al paciente equivocado.

words.en: If you hadn't scanned the wristband, it could have happened.
words.es: Si no hubieras escaneado la pulsera, podría haber pasado.
words.note: Informal (tú), to a coworker.

words.en: We're not looking for someone to blame; we're looking at what failed in the system.
words.es: Aquí no buscamos culpables; buscamos qué falló en el sistema.

words.en: This could have happened to any of us.
words.es: Esto le pudo pasar a cualquiera de nosotros.

words.en: You did the right thing by stopping and speaking up.
words.es: Hiciste bien en detenerte y avisar.
words.note: Informal (tú).

words.en: What could have prevented the mix-up from the start?
words.es: ¿Qué podría haber evitado la confusión desde el principio?

words.en: I propose a name alert on both patients' charts.
words.es: Propongo una alerta de nombre similar en los dos expedientes.

words.en: Do you all agree to move one patient to another room?
words.es: ¿Están de acuerdo en cambiar de cuarto a un paciente?
words.note: Ustedes, to the whole team.

lessons.speaking: You are the charge nurse leading a huddle, and the AI is the new nurse who almost gave a medication to the wrong patient: talk it through without blame using por poco, casi and si no hubieras…, podría haber…, and agree on one change for next time.

grammar.focus: Casi, por poco, podría haber; si clauses (por poco le damos la medicina al paciente equivocado; si Daniel no hubiera revisado la pulsera, podría haber pasado)

examples.es: Por poco le damos la medicina al paciente del cuarto de al lado.
examples.en: We almost gave the medication to the patient in the room next door.

examples.es: Si no hubiera revisado la pulsera, podría haber pasado.
examples.en: If he hadn't checked the wristband, it could have happened.

lessons.title: Stop the Blood: Suspected Transfusion Reaction
lessons.objective: Stop a transfusion per protocol, give short phone commands for help, and tell the patient what happens next.

words.note: The tubing with the blood filter; it goes back to the blood bank with the bag.

words.en: Sir, I'm going to stop the transfusion, as the protocol says.
words.es: Señor, voy a detener la transfusión, como indica el protocolo.
words.note: Formal, to the patient.

words.en: Per the protocol, I'll keep the line open with saline.
words.es: Según el protocolo, mantendré la vía abierta con solución salina.

words.en: This is the nurse in 412; come now, possible transfusion reaction.
words.es: Habla la enfermera de la 412; venga ya, posible reacción transfusional.
words.note: Short and direct on the phone.

words.en: Bring the reaction kit to 412, please.
words.es: Traiga el kit de reacción a la 412, por favor.

words.en: Doctor, at 15 minutes he had chills and lower back pain.
words.es: Doctor, a los 15 minutos tuvo escalofríos y dolor lumbar.

words.en: If you need anything else, I'll send it with the bag and the samples.
words.es: Si necesitan algo más, se lo mandaré con la bolsa y las muestras.
words.note: To the blood bank.

words.en: We'll take blood and urine samples to check the reaction.
words.es: Le tomaremos sangre y orina para revisar la reacción.

words.en: If you feel anything new, let me know; I'll be right here with you.
words.es: Si siente algo nuevo, avíseme; yo estaré aquí con usted.
words.note: Formal, calm tone with the patient.

lessons.speaking: You are the patient's nurse, and the AI is the physician on the phone, then the charge nurse, then the patient: report the symptoms and tell the physician venga ya, ask the charge nurse to traiga el kit, and tell the patient what will happen next using si + present → future.

grammar.focus: Si + present → future; short phone commands (si veo señales de reacción, pararé la transfusión de inmediato; venga ya a la 412; traiga el kit de reacción)

examples.es: Si veo señales de reacción, pararé la transfusión de inmediato.
examples.en: If I see signs of a reaction, I'll stop the transfusion immediately.

examples.es: Doctor, venga ya a la 412. Carmen, traiga el kit de reacción.
examples.en: Doctor, come to 412 now. Carmen, bring the reaction kit.

lessons.title: Accreditation Surveyor Follows Your Patient
lessons.objective: Answer a surveyor formally and explain how procedures are done on the unit, citing policy when asked.

words.note: la evaluadora for a woman.
Also called restricciones.

words.en: I'd be glad to explain how restraints are checked here.
words.es: Con gusto le explico cómo se revisan las sujeciones aquí.
words.note: Formal (usted), to the surveyor.

words.en: They're checked as often as the hospital policy states.
words.es: Se revisan con la frecuencia que indica la política del hospital.

words.en: Circulation, skin and position are checked.
words.es: Se verifican la circulación, la piel y la posición.

words.en: Everything is documented on the monitoring flow sheet, per policy.
words.es: Se documenta todo en la hoja de vigilancia, según la política.

words.en: Less restrictive alternatives are tried first, and that's documented too.
words.es: Primero se intentan alternativas menos restrictivas, y eso también se documenta.

words.en: Would you like me to show you the order in the chart?
words.es: ¿Desea que le muestre la orden en el expediente?
words.note: Formal.

words.en: I don't want to guess; let me check it in the policy.
words.es: No quiero adivinar; permítame verificarlo en la política.

words.en: Excuse me, a patient is calling; may I have a minute?
words.es: Disculpe, un paciente está llamando; ¿me permite un minuto?
words.note: Polite and formal.

lessons.speaking: You are the patient's nurse, and the AI is an accreditation surveyor tracing your patient's care: answer formally with usted and explain how restraints are checked and documented using passive se (se verifican, se documenta), citing the hospital policy when asked.

grammar.focus: Formal register; passive se for procedures (se verifican dos identificadores; se documenta según la política del hospital)

examples.es: Se verifican dos identificadores antes de cada medicamento.
examples.en: Two identifiers are checked before every medication.

examples.es: Se documenta cada revisión según la política del hospital.
examples.en: Each check is documented according to hospital policy.

lessons.title: Writing the Shift Summary and a Late-Entry Note
lessons.objective: Write a clear end-of-shift summary and a correctly labeled late entry for an event charted after the fact.

words.note: Label it clearly as a late entry and give the real event time, as your hospital policy requires.
Dejar constancia = to put on record.

words.en: This is a late entry, per hospital policy.
words.es: Esta es una anotación tardía, según la política del hospital.

words.en: First, the patient reported abdominal pain at 14:00.
words.es: En primer lugar, la paciente refirió dolor abdominal a las 14:00.
words.note: Refirió (reported) is standard written charting register.

words.en: Subsequently, the on-call physician was notified at 14:20.
words.es: Posteriormente, se notificó al médico de guardia a las 14:20.

words.en: It should be noted that the call was not documented on time.
words.es: Cabe señalar que la llamada no se documentó a tiempo.

words.en: Therefore, it is being entered now with the actual time of the event.
words.es: Por lo tanto, se registra ahora con la hora real del evento.

words.en: The original note is not changed; a late entry is added.
words.es: No se modifica la nota original; se agrega una anotación tardía.

words.en: At the end of the shift, the patient is stable and pain-free.
words.es: Al final del turno, la paciente se encuentra estable y sin dolor.

words.en: Hey, I forgot to chart a call; I'm doing the late entry right now.
words.es: Oye, se me pasó documentar una llamada; ahorita hago la anotación tardía.
words.note: Informal, to the charge nurse.

lessons.speaking: You are the nurse, and the AI is the charge nurse reviewing your charting: read aloud your late entry and shift summary, labeling the late entry per hospital policy and linking events with en primer lugar, posteriormente, cabe señalar que and por lo tanto.

grammar.focus: Written register; report connectors (en primer lugar, posteriormente, cabe señalar que, por lo tanto)

examples.es: En primer lugar, se revisaron los signos vitales a las 07:00.
examples.en: First, vital signs were checked at 07:00.

examples.es: Posteriormente, el médico respondió; luego, se notificó a la enfermera encargada.
examples.en: Subsequently, the physician responded; then, the charge nurse was notified.

lessons.title: A Caller Asks for Updates: Privacy on the Phone
lessons.objective: Handle a phone call and a text request from relatives politely while protecting patient privacy.

words.note: Usually said as in English; you can explain it as la ley de privacidad.
¿Cuál es su parentesco con la paciente? = How are you related to the patient?
Common in Mexico: dejar un recado = leave a message.

words.en: Surgical unit, this is nurse Martínez, how can I help you?
words.es: Unidad de cirugía, habla la enfermera Martínez, ¿en qué le puedo ayudar?
words.note: Formal phone greeting.

words.en: Could you give me the patient's privacy code?
words.es: ¿Me podría dar el código de privacidad de la paciente?
words.note: Formal; the conditional softens the request.

words.en: I'm sorry, without the code I can't give any information.
words.es: Lo siento, sin el código no puedo dar ninguna información.

words.en: I understand you're worried about your sister.
words.es: Entiendo que está preocupado por su hermana.

words.en: I would suggest talking with her directly or with her authorized contact.
words.es: Le sugeriría hablar con ella directamente o con su contacto autorizado.

words.en: If you'd like, I could leave the patient a message.
words.es: Si gusta, podría dejarle un recado a la paciente.

words.en: For privacy reasons, we don't give information by text message.
words.es: Por privacidad, no damos información por mensaje de texto.

words.en: Hey, if that man calls again, transfer him to me.
words.es: Oye, si vuelve a llamar ese señor, pásamelo a mí.
words.note: Informal, to a coworker.

lessons.speaking: You are the nurse, and the AI is a caller asking about a patient: answer the unit phone properly, verify the caller's identity and the privacy code before sharing anything, and stay polite with ¿me podría…? and le sugeriría….

grammar.focus: Phone and text conventions; conditional politeness (¿me podría dar el código de la paciente?; le sugeriría hablar con su hermana directamente)

examples.es: ¿Me podría decir su nombre completo y su parentesco con la paciente?
examples.en: Could you tell me your full name and your relationship to the patient?

examples.es: Le sugeriría hablar con su hermana directamente.
examples.en: I would suggest talking with your sister directly.

lessons.title: Discharge Day When the Patient Says No One Can Help
lessons.objective: Do a final discharge check, explain under what conditions the patient can go home safely, and escalate.

words.note: Common in Mexico for wound care; hacerse las curaciones = do your own dressing changes.
Regadera = shower in Mexico; ducha in other countries.

words.en: Ma'am, who is going to help you with the dressing changes at home?
words.es: Señora, ¿quién le va a ayudar con las curaciones en casa?
words.note: Formal, to the patient.

words.en: Thank you for telling me; it's important to know before you go.
words.es: Gracias por decírmelo; es importante saberlo antes de irse.

words.en: You could go home today, as long as you had help at home.
words.es: Podría irse hoy, siempre que tuviera ayuda en casa.

words.en: Unless you had help, climbing the stairs would be dangerous.
words.es: A menos que tuviera ayuda, subir las escaleras sería peligroso.

words.en: We won't send you home without a safe plan.
words.es: No la vamos a mandar a casa sin un plan seguro.

words.en: Since insurance covers it, a home health nurse could visit you.
words.es: Como el seguro lo cubre, una enfermera a domicilio podría visitarla.

words.en: Could you assess her today? She lives alone and can't do her own dressing changes.
words.es: ¿Podría evaluarla hoy? Vive sola y no puede hacerse las curaciones.
words.note: Professional register, to the case manager.

words.en: I'm going to let the doctor know so he can review the plan.
words.es: Le voy a avisar al médico para que revise el plan.

lessons.speaking: You are the nurse, and the AI is a patient going home today: do the final discharge walkthrough, explain when she can go home safely with podría… siempre que and a menos que + subjunctive, and call the case manager if needed.

grammar.focus: Conditional; subjunctive in conditions (podría irse hoy siempre que alguien le ayudara con las curaciones; a menos que tuviera ayuda, sería peligroso)

examples.es: Podría irse hoy siempre que una enfermera a domicilio la visitara.
examples.en: You could go home today as long as a home health nurse visited you.

examples.es: Se quedaría hasta mañana si el médico cambiara la orden de alta.
examples.en: You would stay until tomorrow if the doctor changed the discharge order.

lessons.title: Capstone: A Full Short-Staffed Med-Surg Shift
lessons.objective: Lead a full hard shift in Spanish: teach, solve problems, handle an emergency, talk to families and report.

words.en: It's important that you ask me before doing something you don't know.
words.es: Es importante que me preguntes antes de hacer algo que no conoces.
words.note: Informal, to the new nurse you precept.

words.en: Let me repeat the result: sodium of 118 for Mrs. Díaz, correct?
words.es: Le repito el resultado: sodio de 118 para la señora Díaz, ¿correcto?

words.en: Ma'am, please don't give him anything we haven't checked.
words.es: Señora, le pido que no le dé nada que no hayamos revisado.
words.note: Formal, to a family member.

words.en: We caught it in time; now we have to report it without blaming anyone.
words.es: Lo detectamos a tiempo; ahora hay que reportarlo sin culpar a nadie.

words.en: If anything changes with the patient in 410, let me know right away.
words.es: Si algo cambia con el paciente del 410, avísenme enseguida.
words.note: Plural command, to the team.

words.en: I'll gladly show you where it is documented in the chart.
words.es: Con gusto le muestro dónde está documentado en el expediente.
words.note: Formal, to the surveyor.

words.en: In summary, it was a short-staffed shift; two events are worth noting.
words.es: En resumen, fue un turno con poco personal; cabe destacar dos eventos.

lessons.speaking: You are the nurse leading a short-staffed med-surg shift, and the AI plays a new nurse, the lab, a relative and a surveyor: precept, read back a critical value, stop home medicine, report a near miss and summarize, using commands, subjunctive, si clauses and connectors.

grammar.focus: Capstone: integrating the Master 20 grammar (connectors, commands, subjunctive, si clauses, formal and written register)

examples.es: Si el laboratorio vuelve a llamar, pásenme la llamada a mí.
examples.en: If the lab calls again, transfer the call to me.

examples.es: Le recomiendo que no le dé nada de casa hasta que hable con el médico.
examples.en: I recommend you not give him anything from home until you talk with the doctor.
